description: Global npm CLI package registry for required agent command-line tools that are not maintained through Brew or WinGet on every platform.

policy.dependencyPolicy: Do not list transitive npm dependencies.
policy.platformPolicy: Codex is installed through npm on macOS, Linux, and Windows when missing. Gemini is installed through npm on Linux and Windows when the CLI is missing; macOS uses the Brew gemini-cli formula. Claude and GitHub Copilot remain package-manager-managed and are checked through required-cli-tools-registry.json.

tools.purpose: Gemini command-line agent fallback where Brew gemini-cli is not used
